description:
Cast Scholar of the Lost Trove by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Scholar of the Lost Trove enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Impact Tremors.
Resolve the Scholar of the Lost Trove trigger, casting Worldfire from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Worldfire, exiling all permanents, all cards in all hands and graveyards, setting each player's life total to one, and exiling Worldfire.
Resolve the Impact Tremors trigger from step 2, dealing 1 damage to each opponent.
Each opponent loses the game due to having zero life.
